title: New general licence for legal fees paid by designated persons
summary: OFSI has issued Legal Services General Licence INT/2026/11112108, which expires on 28 April 2027. It lets UK law firms and counsel be paid by a designated person for legal advice without a specific licence, if its terms are met.
what_changes: UK law firms and UK counsel who advised a designated person can receive payment from that person without an OFSI specific licence.
Payment is permitted only if the terms of General Licence INT/2026/11112108 are met.
The licence covers most UK autonomous sanctions regimes, listed in Annex 1 of the licence.
It replaces General Licence INT/2026/9512597, which expired on 28 October 2026, and itself expires on 28 April 2027.
who_it_applies_to: UK law firms and counsel who give legal advice to people designated under the UK autonomous sanctions regimes listed in Annex 1.

history.event: OFSI issued General Licence INT/2026/11112108 to replace INT/2026/9512597, which expired on 28 October 2026.
OFSI confirmed General Licence INT/2026/11112108 expires on 28 April 2027.
